details.flavorMarkdown: *A small cave-dwelling bat with oversized ears, thin dark wings and tiny hooked feet. Sound guides it through darkness, while bright light and loud disturbances unsettle its roost.*

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Sound-based sight 6 squares; fails while Deafened and does not penetrate walls.

**Signs:** Fine droppings beneath a dry ceiling shelf.

**Purpose:** Find insects and a quiet roost.

**Tactics and retreat:** Flee light and noise; bite only when trapped.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Open a route to the ceiling and stop pursuing it.

**Habitat:** Wilderness · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** No saleable treasure.

**Summoning:** Animal 1 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/d67e046466bdd5052360b96ed91861d607091446/design/bestiary/summons/cave-bat.md).

**ID:** creature-cave-bat


**Category:** Animal · **Role:** Cavern scout · **CV:** 4

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its minor attack is easier to defend, granting a Boon.

**Reference damage:** 1/1/2

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.1

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=1.000. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/d67e046466bdd5052360b96ed91861d607091446/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
